summary: This study compared two different medications, empagliflozin and vildagliptin, in patients with type 2 diabetes and coronary artery disease, which is a condition where heart arteries are narrowed. Researchers looked at how these treatments affected heart function, swelling markers, and blood fats over six months. The trial was sponsored by Damanhour University and included 120 participants. The status of this trial is Completed.
